briefdescription.para: This example will generate a sine wave audio, pass it through a simple filter chain, and then compute the MD5 checksum of the output data.

detaileddescription.para: This example will generate a sine wave audio, pass it through a simple filter chain, and then compute the MD5 checksum of the output data.The filter chain it uses is: (input) -> abuffer -> volume -> aformat -> abuffersink -> (output)
